description: Frozen input/output pairs for the PR 3 extraction surface: the Engine 3 input contract, the price carrier, the GPU policy, the DFS build assembly, the read-only build/swap verdicts and the composition entry point over in-memory Engine 2 sources. DB-free: every source object is built from literals and the pure candidate/filtering contracts.
timestamp_policy: No ambient clock is read while capturing: every id and timestamp is an input literal, so the document is byte-stable on its baseline commit.

provenance.origin: Captured from the PRE-MOVE implementation under src/recommendation/assembly/ before any module moved into packages/recommendation-core. The committed document is the baseline: do not regenerate it from the extracted code, because a fixture produced by the implementation under test proves nothing.
